rows.label: London Underground
rows.description: public rapid transit system in London, UK
rows.hook: is the oldest metro system in the world, first opened in Victorian times

rows.label: New York City Subway
rows.description: rapid transit system in New York City
rows.hook: runs around the clock every day and has more stations than any other system in the world

rows.label: Delhi Metro
rows.description: rapid transit system in India serving Delhi and surrounding regions
rows.hook: is the biggest and busiest rail network of its kind in its nation, with elevated and underground stations

rows.label: Bay Area Rapid Transit
rows.description: rapid transit system in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States
rows.hook: is the seventh-busiest subway-style network in its country and reaches an airport by automated guideway

rows.label: Chicago "L"
rows.description: rapid transit system in Chicago, Illinois, operated by the CTA
rows.hook: takes its one-letter name from the word elevated and ranks third in busyness among its country's systems

rows.label: Mass Rapid Transit
rows.description: Mass rapid transit system in Singapore
rows.hook: is the main rail backbone of an island city-state, which opened with just five stations

rows.label: Mumbai Metro
rows.description: rapid transit system serving the city of Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
rows.hook: was designed to ease the strain on an overcrowded commuter rail network in a huge coastal city

rows.label: Washington Metro
rows.hook: ranks second in busyness in its country and serves the capital plus parts of Maryland and Virginia

rows.label: Moscow Metro
rows.description: rapid transit system in Moscow agglomeration
rows.hook: is the only system in the world with three circle lines and the longest in Europe

rows.label: SkyTrain
rows.description: automated rapid transit system in Metro Vancouver, Canada

rows.label: Los Angeles Metro Rail
rows.description: urban rail transit system serving Los Angeles County, California, United States

rows.label: Paris Métro
rows.description: rapid transport system of Paris, France
rows.hook: is known for its Art Nouveau station entrances and its dense network packed into the capital

rows.label: Toronto subway
rows.description: rapid transit system in Ontario, Canada

rows.label: Glasgow Subway
rows.description: underground metro line in Glasgow, Scotland, UK
